name: Timna
overview: Timna appears in Scripture as both a woman and a man connected to the lineage of Esau and Seir. She is identified as the concubine of Eliphaz, Esau's son, and the mother of Amalek, highlighting her role in the ancestry of the Amalekites (Genesis 36:12). Additionally, Timna is named as the sister of Lotan, linking her to the family of Seir the Horite (Genesis 36:22; 1 Chronicles 1:39). The name Timna also appears among the sons of Eliphaz, indicating a male descendant bearing the same name (1 Chronicles 1:36). These references collectively situate Timna within the broader genealogical and tribal context surrounding Esau's descendants.
